advancements.strata_epochs.root.title: Strata: Deep Time
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_drill: Right-click the ground to drill a core sample. It shows which epoch lies beneath this region (8×8 chunks).
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_sample: Shows an epoch. Right-click an Epoch Gate with it to travel there. The sample is used up.
jei.strata_bridge.info.epoch_gate: Right-click with a core sample to enter its epoch. Inside an epoch, right-click the gate to return. Gates inside epochs cannot be broken.
jei.strata_bridge.info.time_anchor: Keep it in your inventory to double the time you can stay in an epoch before you solidify.
jei.strata_bridge.info.petrified_stone: Forms around players who stay too long in an epoch.
jade.strata_bridge.gate.enter: Right-click with a core sample to travel
advancements.strata_epochs.met_geode_cra: Meet a Geode Crawler. Follow it to find ore.
advancements.strata_epochs.met_spore_bel: Meet a Spore Bellows. Its clouds make time run faster.
advancements.strata_epochs.met_petrified: Meet a Petrified Witness. Stay too long and you turn to stone.
Read a codex fragment from a Petrified Witness.
jade.strata_bridge.mob.geode_crawler: Crystal Age · neutral, leads to ore
jade.strata_bridge.mob.spore_bellows: Spore Age · spores speed up solidification
jade.strata_bridge.mob.petrified_witness: Echo of a traveller · a pickaxe breaks its stone skin
jei.strata_bridge.info.calcite_scale: Dropped by the Geode Crawler (Crystal Age). Material for geode armor and a second time anchor recipe.
jei.strata_bridge.info.spore_sac: Dropped by the Spore Bellows (Spore Age). Ingredient for the germ tonic and the amber blade.
jei.strata_bridge.info.germ_tonic: Right-click inside an epoch: turns the solidification clock back by 60 seconds.
jei.strata_bridge.info.codex_fragment: Dropped by the Petrified Witness. Right-click unlocks the codex node "Echo of a Traveller".
jei.strata_bridge.info.amber_blade: A sword of amber. Every melee hit slows the target for 2 seconds.
jei.strata_bridge.info.geode_armor: Slightly stronger than iron. With all four pieces, solidification in epochs runs 25% slower.
